data.title: A document whose subject is a person does not go to a public repository
data.why: Four files reached the public repository under the 2026-09-03 rule, which only asks whether a file is generated or machine-specific and says nothing about consent: probe-b-candidates.md names developers with outreach statuses, probe-b-outreach.md holds the messages aimed at them, tech-lead-feedback-2026-09-10.md quotes a private conversation, gtm-first-users.md carries the owner's hours and employer. Citing a public issue as evidence stays; listing the same people as targets does not.
data.rejected: Remove docs/product/ and docs/research/ wholesale as business-internal — pointless while .kadence/events/ stays in git and carries the same strategy, and it would break ~54 links and strip README's evidence; Leave everything and rely on the warning inside probe-b-candidates.md — the warning was already there and did not work
